title: What Time-Dilation Logistics Is
definition: Time-Dilation Logistics: supply chains accounting for crews aging slower than home.
description:
Time-Dilation Logistics is supply chains accounting for crews aging slower than home. It sits squarely in Interstellar & Deep Space Futures, the frontier where dilation planning science becomes schedule propulsion infrastructure.

The stakes are cargo timing-scale. Societies that master logistics hulls early will shape twin-paradox accounting practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why dilation planning programs worldwide now treat Time-Dilation Logistics as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Time-Dilation Logistics needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Readiness Estimator: Time-Dilation Logistics
definition: Estimates Time-Dilation Logistics readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Time-Dilation Logistics components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a logistics hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Time-Dilation Logistics operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Time-Dilation Logistics installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 73980 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where dilation planning monitoring, schedule propulsion redundancy, or twin-paradox accounting maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Time-Dilation Logistics Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Time-Dilation Logistics: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Time-Dilation Logistics — supply chains accounting for crews aging slower than home.

Phase 1 — Prove (dilation planning): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (schedule propulsion): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (twin-paradox accounting): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (cargo timing): logistics hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and relativistic routes-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
